audit.whatIsWrong: Stored chart read Skill/Tahm Kench/Tahm Kench/Skill/Skill/Tahm Kench/Tahm Kench. The packet has Garen for all six pre-item stages with Tahm Kench at two-plus items, and every whys[] on the page already said Garen — whys[0] through whys[5] describe Garen winning each of those stages.
audit.why: Tahm Kench's lane presence before items is one Tongue Lash and a stack counter; his durability comes from Thick Skin, which needs time out of combat to convert. Garen's cost-free Q reset plus Judgment beats that at every pre-item stage. He flips only once he stacks health and becomes a peel and roam tank. Win rate 57.93%.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Garen through First item, Tahm Kench at two-plus items, as one atomic group in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike said 'his W Devour can self-cast to escape'. Devour is his R, not his W, and Riot's text describes it as devouring a champion — damaging an enemy or shielding an ally — with no self-cast escape. The W is Abyssal Dive.
audit.why: The mirror audit reached the same conclusion and re-pointed every reference to Devour (R) or Abyssal Dive (W) as appropriate. What actually threatens the execute window is Thick Skin, a 3-second-cooldown button that converts stored damage into a shield — which is also one of the two flagged missing interactions for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike rewritten around Thick Skin's 3s shield conversion; wants.you[2] re-pointed from 'W Devour' to Abyssal Dive.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gave Abyssal Dive a 12-second cooldown and called it 'his escape + shield'. Riot's values: Abyssal Dive is 21/20/19/18/17 and it dives, damages and KNOCKS UP — it grants no shield. The shield is Thick Skin on a 3-second cooldown. The Tongue Lash stun condition was also never stated: Riot's text says the stun only happens when the target already carries three stacks of An Acquired Taste, and the stacks are then consumed. Nothing said Decisive Strike breaks the Tongue Lash slow.
audit.why: Three separate consequences. The all-in window was keyed to a 12s cooldown that is really 21s at rank 1, so the player was fighting into an available Abyssal Dive roughly half the time. The 'shield' the player was told to wait out belongs to a different ability that comes back every 3 seconds, so waiting is futile — you force it, you do not outlast it. And the stun is conditional and countable: at fewer than three stacks Tongue Lash is only a slow, which Decisive Strike breaks outright, so the tracked resource is the stack count, not a cooldown. The mirror independently corrected the same stack rule.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive at 21s rank 1 with knockup; Thick Skin named as the shield; the three-stack stun condition and the Q slow-break stated across tldr, focus, spikes, whys, early and wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', and the one cooldown given was wrong.
audit.why: The two things that decide whether a commit works are Abyssal Dive (21s at rank 1, his disengage and knockup) and the stack count on An Acquired Taste. Both are visible to the player.
audit.corrected: All-in window now requires Abyssal Dive down AND fewer than three stacks.

notes: Two ability-slot errors fixed: the page called Devour his W (it is his R) and credited Abyssal Dive with a shield (that is Thick Skin, E). Abyssal Dive's cooldown was also given as 12s against a real 21s at rank 1, which made every all-in instruction on the page unsafe. The mirror tahmkench__garen had already corrected the same slot confusion and the three-stack Q stun rule, so both directions now state the same mechanics. Kept 'Grey Health' out of the new text in favour of Thick Skin, the actual ability name. Devour's cooldown is listed as 0 in the kit data, so no cooldown for it is asserted anywhere.
